campuses.text: Главный кампус в историческом Old Royal Naval College (UNESCO World Heritage) на берегу Темзы. Business School, English, Humanities, Architecture, Computing.

campuses.title: Avery Hill Campus
campuses.text: Зелёный кампус в Eltham — Education, Health and Social Care, Sport, Tourism.

campuses.title: Medway Campus
campuses.text: Совместный кампус с Kent и Canterbury Christ Church — Engineering, Pharmacy, Science.

paragraphs: The University of Greenwich is a public university based in London, with the main Greenwich Maritime Campus housed in the historic Old Royal Naval College (UNESCO World Heritage site) on the banks of the Thames. Founded as Woolwich Polytechnic in 1890 and gaining university status in 1992, Greenwich is one of the largest UK universities by enrolment (~21,000 students) with three campuses: Greenwich (Maritime), Avery Hill (south-east London), and Medway (Kent — shared with Kent and Canterbury Christ Church). Strong in Business, Engineering, Computing, Pharmacy, Architecture, and Landscape Architecture.

International students enter via Oxford International pathway programmes — International Foundation, International Year One, and Pre-Master courses lead into a Greenwich Bachelor's or Master's degree.
paragraphsRu: University of Greenwich — государственный университет в Лондоне. Главный Greenwich Maritime кампус — в историческом Old Royal Naval College (UNESCO World Heritage) на берегу Темзы. Основан как Woolwich Polytechnic в 1890, статус университета с 1992. Один из крупнейших UK университетов (~21 000 студентов) — 3 кампуса: Greenwich (Maritime), Avery Hill (юго-восток Лондона) и Medway (Kent — совместно с Kent и Canterbury Christ Church). Сильные направления: бизнес, инженерия, computing, фармация, архитектура.
Международные студенты заходят через pathway-программы Oxford International — International Foundation, International Year One и Pre-Master ведут в бакалавриат / магистратуру Greenwich.
